commits.message:
Feature/gh aw 3 (#763)

* Add protected-files fallback handling to workflow

Update sync_open_prs_with_main workflow to avoid pushing changes to protected files. Adds protected_files_policy: "fallback-to-issue" to GH_AW_SAFE_OUTPUTS_HANDLER_CONFIG in the lock file, and documents the new protected-files: fallback-to-issue option and fallback behavior in the workflow README. Also updates the workflow lock metadata (frontmatter hash). This ensures merges that would modify protected files create an issue instead of force-pushing changes to PR branches.

* Add triage_incoming_bug_reports workflow lockfile

Add a new GitHub Actions workflow for triaging incoming bug reports (.github/workflows/triage_incoming_bug_reports.md) and its compiled lockfile (.github/workflows/triage_incoming_bug_reports.lock.yml). The lockfile was auto-generated by gh-aw (v0.62.5) and provisions a full agent pipeline using the GitHub Copilot CLI: setup, safe-outputs MCP server, MCP gateway, agent execution, threat detection, artifact upload, and conclusion steps (comments/labels/discussions). DO NOT EDIT the lockfile directly — update the .md source and run `gh aw compile` as noted in the generated header.

* Add changelog workflow documentation

Remove the existing auto_change_log.yml workflow and add auto_change_log.md documenting the changelog automation. The new markdown describes goals and step-by-step behavior for generating CHANGELOG.md with git-chglog, smart diff detection to avoid timestamp-only PR noise, branch/PR conventions, required PR body content, triggers (release, push on main, workflow_dispatch), permissions, and constraints. This commit moves the workflow implementation details into a readable spec for the automation and documents installation/usage notes and expected behavior.

* Add update_docker_netsnmp_versions workflow

Add a new gh-aw-generated workflow (update_docker_netsnmp_versions.md/.lock.yml) that schedules and runs an agent to update Docker Net-SNMP versions, including safe-outputs config (title prefix [docker-netsnmp-update]) and full activation/agent/detection/conclusion steps. Also trim automated PR labels for the coverage-autofix workflow: remove the additional labels (coverage, tests, cpp, python) in both the .md and the compiled .lock.yml, and update the gh-aw metadata hash in the compiled coverage lock file.

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+---
+name: Triage Incoming Bug Reports
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  issues:
+    types: [opened, edited, reopened]
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+  issues: read
+safe-outputs:
+  add-comment:
+    target: triggering
+    hide-older-comments: true
+  add-labels:
+    target: triggering
+    allowed: [bug, needs-info, triaged]
+  remove-labels:
+    target: triggering
+    allowed: [needs-info]
+timeout-minutes: 20
+engine:
+  id: copilot
+  model: auto
+network:
+  allowed: [defaults, github]
+tools:
+  bash: true
+---
+
+# Bug Report Intake Triage
+
+Triage incoming bug reports and ensure required fields from the bug template are present and filled.
+
+## Gate
+
+Only run triage logic when all conditions are true:
+
+- The event is for an issue (not a PR).
+- The issue has the `bug` label or the title starts with `[BUG]`.
+
+If not a bug report, post no comment and do no label changes.
+
+## Required Sections
+
+Validate these required template sections are present and meaningfully filled (not placeholders, not empty, not unchanged example text):
+
+1. EzSNMP release version OR commit number
+2. Operating System and Version
+3. Python 3 Version
+4. Net-SNMP Library Version
+5. Describe the bug
+6. To Reproduce (concrete reproducible steps)
+7. Expected behavior
+8. Additional context (logs, stack trace, debugger output, or explicit statement that none is available)
+
+Treat the report as incomplete if values are placeholders such as:
+
+- `[e.g. ...]`
+- `...`
+- `N/A` with no explanation in critical fields
+- unchanged template examples
+
+## Creative Triage Output
+
+Compute a simple **Intake Score** from 0-8 based on the required sections above.
+
+Then do exactly one of these paths:
+
+### Path A: Incomplete Report (score < 8)
+
+1. Add label `needs-info`.
+2. Remove label `triaged` if present.
+3. Add one concise triage comment that includes:
+   - Intake score (`x/8`)
+   - A checkbox list of missing or weak sections
+   - A copy-paste reporter checklist asking for exact missing details
+   - A friendly note that triage will continue automatically after they edit the issue
+
+### Path B: Complete Report (score = 8)
+
+1. Remove label `needs-info` if present.
+2. Add label `triaged`.
+3. Add one concise triage comment that includes:
+   - Intake score (`8/8`)
+   - A short summary of environment and reproduction signal quality
+   - A note that the issue is ready for technical investigation
+
+## Constraints
+
+- Do not modify issue title/body.
+- Do not close issues.
+- Keep comments factual and brief.
+- Avoid duplicate comments: rely on `hide-older-comments: true` and post only one fresh status comment per run.
